  PROBLEM: The `wrapper-main` function creates a temp prompt file, sets a trap, then does `cat > "${prompt_file}"` without redirecting stdin from the caller.
  WHY: When the wrapper is used via PATH override, stdin is consumed by the wrapper but never passed to the real `codex` in the fallback exec path after a failed resume, so the continuation-transformed prompt is lost.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:446 (wrapper generation) & 492 (exec) | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The generated wrapper uses `exec bash $(printf '%q' "${helper_path}") wrapper-main "$@"` with unquoted command substitution.
  WHY: If the helper path contains spaces, word-splitting occurs after the `%q` quoting, breaking the wrapper and defeating thread reuse.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:85 (runtime_root), 300 (record_session_from_marker), 630 (direct-run) | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When `RUNTIME_DIR`/`CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_RUNTIME_DIR` is unset, the marker-recording path still does an unconditional `rglob("*.jsonl")` over `~/.codex/sessions` and then runs `codex_thread_reuse_record_session_from_marker` even in the `CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_ENABLED=false` case.
  WHY: This adds unnecessary I/O and shared-root race potential during parallel workflow runs, violating the default-off clean-fallback expectation.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:338–350 (record_session_from_marker Python block) | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The Python snippet treats a missing `cwd` key (or explicit `null`) by doing `session_cwd = meta.get("cwd") or ""`, but then immediately uses `os.path.realpath(session_cwd)` without a further `if not isinstance(session_cwd, str) or not session_cwd:` guard before the comparison.
  WHY: A `None` cwd can still trigger `TypeError: realpath() argument must be str, bytes or os.PathLike, not NoneType`, causing session capture to fail and forcing full-prompt retries.
- prompts/mode-*-continuation.txt (all three) | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The role line still contains the duplicated "same same-run" text that was flagged in prior autofix rounds.
  WHY: The continuation prompt sent to the model contains a clear typo, reducing clarity and violating the functionally equivalent acceptance criterion.
